**No—not yet.** Hansen/UMD mapped a candidate tree-cover loss of approximately 13.5 ha in 2025, or 3.91% of the property. The JRC 2020 forest reference agrees over 98% of the event area, but 2025 is the latest observed year, so no later observation is available to corroborate the loss or establish persistence.

The evidence also does not establish deforestation, a change in land use, or the cause of the loss.
